" alt="Monochrome streetwear sneakers"><span class="lb-label">Footwear</span></a><a href="#shop" class="lookbook-tile"><img loading="lazy" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Black-and-white backpack"><span class="lb-label">The everyday edit</span></a></div></section>
<section class="black-banner"><span class="eyebrow">DRESS CODE / NONE</span><h2 class="headline">BE THE<br>EXCEPTION.</h2><p>You're not here to disappear. Neither are we.</p><a href="#shop" class="btn light" style="margin-top:25px">Discover the collection →</a></section>
<section class="section container">${titlebar('03 / Studio staples','SOMETHING<br>DIFFERENT',`<a href="#shop" class="link-arrow">Shop all →</a>`)}${tiles(catalog.slice(4,8))}</section>
${newsletter()}`}
function newsletter(){return `<section class="newsletter"><div class="container"><span class="eyebrow red">THE INSIDE LINE</span><h2 class="headline">STAY IN<br>YOUR LANE.<br><span style="color:var(--red)">OR DON'T.</span></h2><p>Join the mailing list for concept drops, campaign updates, and the unexpected.<br><small>Demo only. Email is saved in this browser, not sent to a server.</small></p><form onsubmit="submitNewsletter(event)"><input aria-label="Email address" required type="email" id="newsletter-email" placeholder="Your email address"><button class="btn" type="submit">Join the list →</button></form></div></section>`}
function shopPage(){const filtered=getFiltered();return `<section class="page-hero"><div class="container"><span class="eyebrow red">ZEBRA / THE COLLECTION</span><h1 class="headline">THE NEW<br>UNIFORM.</h1><p>Not everyone was made to follow the same lines. Explore our sample collection and find your way.</p></div></section><section class="catalog-layout container"><div class="catalog-top"><div class="filter-buttons">${cats.map(c=>`<button class="filter-btn ${state.category===c?'active':''}" onclick="setCategory('${c}')">${c}</button>`).join('')}</div><label class="eyebrow" style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center">SORT BY <select class="sort-select" onchange="setSort(this.value)"><option value="featured" ${state.sort==='featured'?'selected':''}>Featured</option><option value="price-low" ${state.sort==='price-low'?'selected':''}>Price: low to high</option><option value="price-high" ${state.sort==='price-high'?'selected':''}>Price: high to low</option><option value="alpha" ${state.sort==='alpha'?'selected':''}>Name A–Z</option></select></label></div><p class="results-count">${filtered.length} ITEMS / SAMPLE PRODUCTS ${state.search?' · SEARCH: '+escapeHTML(state.search):''}</p>${tiles(filtered)}</section>${newsletter()}`}
function getFiltered(){let x=catalog.filter(p=>(state.category==='All'||p.category===state.category)&&(`${p.name} ${p.category} ${p.description}`.toLowerCase().includes(state.search.toLowerCase())));if(state.sort==='price-low')x.sort((a,b)=>a.price-b.price);if(state.sort==='price-high')x.sort((a,b)=>b.price-a.price);if(state.sort==='alpha')x.sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name));return x}
function setCategory(c){state.category=c;document.getElementById('app').innerHTML=shopPage()}
function setSort(v){state.sort=v;document.getElementById('app').innerHTML=shopPage()}
function resetFilters(){state.category='All';state.search='';state.sort='featured';navigate('shop')}
function detailsPage(id){const p=product(id);if(!p)return notFound();state.qty=1;state.size=null;state.color=p.colors[0];const rec=catalog.filter(x=>x.id!==p.id).slice(0,4);return `<div class="container"><div class="breadcrumbs"><a href="#home">Home</a> / <a href="#shop">Collection</a> / ${p.category} / ${p.name}</div><div class="product-detail"><div class="pd-image"><img src="${photo(p)}" alt="${escapeHTML(p.name)} large product view"><span class="detail-counter">01 / PRODUCT CONCEPT</span></div><div class="pd-content"><span class="eyebrow red">ZEBRA STUDIO / ${p.category}</span><h1 class="headline">${p.name}</h1><span class="pd-price">${money(p.price)}</span><p class="pd-desc">${p.description}</p><div class="label-row"><span>Colour: <span id="color-value" style="font-weight:500">${p.colors[0]}</span></span></div><div class="color-options">${p.colors.map((c,i)=>`<button class="color-btn ${i===0?'selected':''}" title="${c}" aria-label="${c}" onclick="selectColor(${i},'${p.id}',this)"><span style="background:${c==='Black'||c==='Midnight'?'#151515':c==='Mono'?'linear-gradient(135deg,#111 0 48%,#fff 48% 55%,#111 55%)':'linear-gradient(125deg,#111 0 46%,#eee 46% 57%,#111 57%)'}"></span></button>`).join('')}</div><div class="label-row"><span>Select size <span id="size-value"></span></span><button onclick="openModal('size')">Size guide</button></div><div class="size-options">${p.sizes.map(s=>`<button class="size-btn" onclick="selectSize('${escapeHTML(s)}',this)">${s}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="pd-addrow"><div class="qty-picker"><button aria-label="Decrease quantity" onclick="changeQuantity(-1)">−</button><span id="detail-qty">1</span><button aria-label="Increase quantity" onclick="changeQuantity(1)">+</button></div><button class="btn" onclick="addCurrent('${p.id}')">Add to bag →</button><button class="btn outline" aria-label="Toggle wishlist" style="flex:0;min-width:55px;padding:0 15px" onclick="toggleWish('${p.id}');this.textContent=state.wishlist.includes('${p.id}')?'♥':'♡'">${state.wishlist.includes(p.id)?'♥':'♡'}</button></div><p class="pd-fine">Sample products and prices. Checkout is a simulation. No real payment or delivery.</p><details class="accordion" open><summary>Details & fit</summary><p>${p.details}</p></details><details class="accordion"><summary>Care instructions</summary><p>Illustrative care information only. Read the actual garment's care label on a production item.</p></details><details class="accordion"><summary>Delivery & returns</summary><p>This is an interactive concept store. All displayed shipping, pricing and product details are illustrative. No orders are fulfilled.</p></details></div></div></div><section class="recommend container">${titlebar('Selected for you','PAIR IT<br>YOUR WAY')}${tiles(rec)}</section>`}
function selectSize(s,btn){state.size=s;document.querySelectorAll('.size-btn').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('selected',x===btn));const e=document.getElementById('size-value');if(e)e.textContent=' / '+s}
function selectColor(i,id,btn){const p=product(id);state.color=p.colors[i];document.querySelectorAll('.color-btn').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('selected',x===btn));const e=document.getElementById('color-value');if(e)e.textContent=state.color}
function changeQuantity(d){state.qty=Math.min(20,Math.max(1,state.qty+d));const e=document.getElementById('detail-qty');if(e)e.textContent=state.qty}
function addCurrent(id){const p=product(id);if(!state.size){toast('Choose a size first.');return}addToCart(id,state.size,state.color||p.colors[0],state.qty);openCart()}
function addToCart(id,size,color,qty=1){const key=[id,size,color].join('|');let existing=state.cart.find(x=>x.key===key);if(existing)existing.qty+=qty;else state.cart.push({key,id,size,color,qty});persist();updateBadges();toast(product(id).name+' added to your bag.')}
function toggleWish(id){if(state.wishlist.includes(id))state.wishlist=state.wishlist.filter(x=>x!==id);else state.wishlist.push(id);persist();updateBadges();let route=currentRoute();if(route==='wishlist')render();else document.querySelectorAll('.product-card').forEach(x=>{let button=x.querySelector('.wish-btn');if(button){let href=x.querySelector('.product-title a')?.getAttribute('href');if(href==='#product/'+id)button.classList.toggle('saved',state.wishlist.includes(id))}});toast(state.wishlist.includes(id)?'Added to your wishlist.':'Removed from your wishlist.')}
function wishlistPage(){const l=catalog.filter(x=>state.wishlist.includes(x.id));return `<section class="page-hero"><div class="container"><span class="eyebrow red">THE GOOD LIST</span><h1 class="headline">YOUR<br>FAVOURITES.</h1><p>Save the pieces you keep coming back to. This list stays in your browser.</p></div></section><section class="section container">${l.length?tiles(l):`<div class="empty-state"><h3>Nothing saved. Yet.</h3><p>Find something you love and tap the heart.</p><a class="btn" href="#shop">Explore the collection →</a></div>`}</section>`}
function lookbookPage(){return `<section class="editorial-hero"><div class="ed-copy"><span class="eyebrow red">CAMPAIGN 001 / FALL IN LINE? NEVER.</span><h1 class="headline">A NEW<br>KIND OF<br>CROSSING.</h1><p>Four stripes, one city, infinite ways to move through it. An editorial story in black, white, and the space between.</p><a class="btn light" href="#shop" style="align-self:flex-start;margin-top:20px">Shop the edit →</a></div><div class="ed-img" role="img" aria-label="Zebras crossing a dramatic city street"></div></section><div class="container"><div class="editorial-gallery"><div class="editorial-cell tall"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Black woman wearing a zebra overshirt"><div class="overlay">01 / The street is yours</div></div><div class="editorial-cell"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
